passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Ocimum carnosum (Spreng.) Link & Otto ex Benth..
The native range of this species is Mexico, N. Venezuela, S. Bolivia to Brazil and N. Argentina. It is an annual or subshrub and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.
